s01: Find a clock with a second hand. Look away, then look back.
s02: The first second is too long.
s03: It just hangs there. Then it ticks on, perfectly normal.
s04: The clock is fine. You were not there.
s05: Your eyes do not glide. They jump. Three, four times a second.
s06: And while they are moving, the picture is switched off.
s07: You would see a smear otherwise. So your brain cuts it out.
s08: But now there is a hole in the tape.
s09: So it fills the hole backwards, with the first thing you land on.
s10: That is your long second. It is not a long second at all.
s11: It is a blank, painted over with the clock.
s13: Something like a tenth of your waking life happens with the lights off.
s14: And the one time you catch it, you blame the clock.
